title: Platform settings
description: Settings for the platform AI agent, its tools and the permission system. This file is generated — do not edit it by hand, change platform-config/src/sxema.ts instead.

maksXabar.description: Maximum number of messages sent to the LLM. Older ones are dropped (compacted first if compaction is enabled).

toolNatijasiChegarasi.description: Maximum length (characters) of a single tool result stored in history, so long `read`/`bash` output does not swamp the context.

yoqilgan.description: Automatically compact history when the context fills up. If disabled, a long conversation stops fitting in the context window.

zaxiraTokenlar.description: Part of the context window reserved for the summary prompt and the response. Compaction starts once the context exceeds (window - reserve).

saqlanadiganTokenlar.description: How much of the most recent context is kept verbatim after compaction. A larger value keeps recent history more precise but makes compaction less effective.

modeli.description: Model used for compaction, as `provider/model`. When `null` the main chat model is used (summary quality matters, hence the default).

yoqilgan.description: Tools given to the agent. A tool removed from the list is invisible — the agent does not know it exists.

bashTimeoutSekund.description: Maximum run time for a single `bash` command. Waiting forever would freeze the web session.

natijaChegarasi.description: Maximum length (characters) of a tool result sent to the UI. The limit for what is stored in history is configured separately.

rejim.description: Initial permission mode for a new session. `tasdiq` asks about every dangerous action; `auto` lets the classifier decide.

kutishSoniya.description: How long to wait for an answer to a permission request. On timeout the request is DENIED, so the agent does not hang forever.

klassifikatorModeli.description: Model for the auto-mode classifier, as `provider/model`. When `null` it is chosen automatically (fast, proven models first).

ketmaKetBlokChegarasi.description: Auto mode turns off after the classifier blocks this many actions in a row — the agent may be going beyond what was asked.

jamiBlokChegarasi.description: Auto mode turns off after this many blocks in total during a session.

qoshimchaTaqiqlar.description: Additional forbidden command names. They are ADDED to the built-in hard block list, never replace it — the security boundary cannot be lowered.

ishPapkasi.description: Root directory the agent tools work in. When `null`, `~/.platforma/ishlar/` is used.

faolsizlikDaqiqa.description: In-memory resources of a session idle for this long (permission state, mode) are cleaned up. The conversation history stays in the database.

ulanishTimeoutSekund.description: Maximum wait for the MCP server handshake. If the server does not respond the session continues — only that server is unavailable.

chaqiruvTimeoutSekund.description: Maximum wait for a single MCP tool call.

maksFaylMb.description: Maximum size (MB) of a single file attached to a chat.

maksSoni.description: Maximum number of files attached to a single message.
